svg.title: CloudSentry scan workflow
svg.desc: Twelve steps run by AWS Step Functions: validate account, assume the read-only role, discover resources with 16 parallel workers, collect CloudWatch metrics, read AWS costs, normalize, run detection rules, generate recommendations, estimate savings, persist results, write the scan summary and send notifications. Metrics, costs and notifications never fail a scan; any unexpected error marks the scan failed.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: AWS Step Functions (Standard). State stays small; every step writes its output to S3.
